title: Open the onboarding link
steps: Open tinyurl.com/indosat-smb, or scan the QR code from the session.
expected: Owner onboarding starts in the web chat and asks the first business-profile question.

title: Set up the business profile
steps: Answer each onboarding question: business name, opening hours and services.
expected: It asks each question clearly, accepts your answers, and moves to the next step without asking again for something you already gave.

title: Correct an answer during onboarding
steps: During R1.2, give your hours, then correct them, e.g. "Sorry, we close at 9pm, not 8pm."
expected: It uses the corrected answer. The old value isn't kept alongside the new one.

title: Add products from a menu photo
steps: At the product catalog step, upload a picture of a menu.
expected: It reads the products and prices from the photo correctly, shows them back to you, and doesn't add anything that isn't on the menu.

title: Add products by typing them in
steps: Onboard again (or add to your catalog) by typing product details, e.g. "Jasmine milk tea $6, strawberry mochi $3."
expected: Each product is saved with the right name and price.

title: Agent created and phone line attached
expected: A receptionist agent is created from your business profile, and it shows the phone number attached to it.
notes: Calling the number is for the voice phase, not today.

title: Business and products show correctly in memory
steps: After onboarding, check the business and products in memory (or ask the owner chat "What are our hours?" and "What's on our menu?").
expected: The business name, hours and services match your answers. Each product is saved as its own item with the right price and shown as available.
